note: Buyer committees from icp-round-2 (analyst research, not buyer interviews) and fit statuses from the GTM map. Do not edit by hand; rebuild.

roles.typical_titles: MD and CEO; Chief Financial Officer; Chief Operating Officer
roles.owns: The budget for collections and customer service. Also the cost-to-income target.
roles.cares_about: Cost per call and cost per rupee collected. Recovery that does not rise with headcount. Bajaj's technology and operations chief says the AI cost must be below the human cost. He gives one-third as the voice AI figure. The link to Sarvam is INFERENCE.
roles.blocks_if: The pilot has no result the CFO can check against the human baseline. Or the vendor price rises as call volume grows.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Credit Officer; Head of Collections; Chief Credit and Collections Officer
roles.owns: Recovery targets by overdue bucket. The size and rules of the calling team.
roles.cares_about: Flow rates from early to late buckets. Bounce rate (failed repayments) and collection efficiency. Kissht reports a 13.1% bounce rate and 97.01% collection efficiency. AU reports 99.5% collection efficiency. The two firms may measure it in different ways.
roles.blocks_if: The bot cannot capture a promise to pay or route a hard case to a human. Or it hurts repayment rates in a pilot.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Head of Customer Service; Chief of Operations and Customer Service; Head of Operations; Chief Customer Service Officer
roles.owns: The contact centre, service requests and complaint handling. Often the first daily user of a voice agent.
roles.cares_about: Share of calls handled with no manual step. ABCL says 63% of contact centre interactions went through straight-through processing (STP, which means no manual step). Languages the floor cannot cover.
roles.blocks_if: Agents must type the data in again after the bot hands off. Or the bot fails in a language the team does not speak.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Technology Officer; Chief Information Officer; Chief Digital and AI Officer
roles.owns: Links to the loan origination and loan management systems, the dialer and the call-recording stack. Security review.
roles.cares_about: Speed of reply, links to the dialer and the core systems, call recording, and who can reach call data. AU names a Chief Digital and AI Officer on its call.
roles.blocks_if: The vendor cannot show where it stores call audio. Or it cannot link to the dialer. Or one model does not cover the languages the lender serves.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Risk Officer; Chief Compliance Officer
roles.owns: Recovery conduct policy, the code of conduct for agents and staff, and call records.
roles.cares_about: RBI recovery directions of 6 Aug 2026 (in force 1 Jan 2027). They apply to NBFCs. Banks have separate directions with the same recording and call-hour rules. Calls only between 08:00 and 19:00 (unless the borrower expressly asks or authorises another time). Call time and number of calls documented. Call content recorded and kept six months. Recovery agents hold an IIBF certificate within one year. Graded escalation matrix. The lender stays answerable for its recovery agents.
roles.blocks_if: A voice agent calls outside hours, or calls too often, or records nothing. Or the vendor cannot prove it follows the lender's code of conduct.
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.role: Risk and compliance (grievance and vendor risk)
roles.typical_titles: Grievance Redressal Officer; Principal Nodal Officer; Head of Outsourcing or Vendor Risk
roles.owns: Outsourcing policy and vendor checks. Complaint handling under the RBI Fair Practices Code and the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme.
roles.cares_about: RBI outsourcing directions of 28 Nov 2025: the lender is responsible for the actions of its service provider, recovery agents included. The lender keeps ultimate control. The lender must display the name and contact details of its grievance officer.
roles.blocks_if: The vendor is a black box. Or the contract does not let the lender audit calls, or the vendor cannot show how it keeps a complaint trail.
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Head of Procurement; Vendor Management; Chief Operating Officer office
roles.owns: Commercial terms, the price model and the contract.
roles.cares_about: A per-minute price the lender can test on a small pilot. Sarvam's page lists Rs 3.50 a minute pay as you go, plus telephony. Compare completed outcomes, not the headline rate.
roles.blocks_if: Telephony, setup and integration costs are not on the quote. Or the price is not published.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Digital Officer; Head of Digital; AI or Transformation lead
roles.owns: The proof of concept. PNB Housing says it finished a Voice AI proof of concept for pre-due collections. ABCL says it deploys Voice AI across onboarding, servicing and cross sell.
roles.cares_about: A result the lender can show its own board. A small first test that does not need a long project.
roles.blocks_if: The sponsor leaves, or the proof of concept has no named owner after the pilot.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: MD & CEO; Executive Director; CFO
roles.owns: The budget and the final yes
roles.cares_about: Cost per claim and per call, fewer grievances, IRDAI standing (INFERENCE)
roles.blocks_if: No pass bar the insurer sets itself; no public customer result in India
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Health UW & Claims, Customer Service & Operations; Chief Operating Officer; Head of Claims
roles.owns: Claims turnaround, claim-status calls, customer service
roles.cares_about: Grievances and pendency (IRDAI Tables 37 and 56), IRDAI 14-day complaint resolution, claim-status call volume
roles.blocks_if: Voice agent adds a new failure in a claim journey; no human hand-off
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Chief Distribution Officer; Chief Business Officer; Chief Marketing Officer
roles.owns: Renewals, persistency, agent and bank channels, Tier 2/3 growth
roles.cares_about: 13-month persistency (HDFC Life 84%), renewal reminders in the customer's language, agent training in new regions
roles.blocks_if: Cannot show a lift in renewals or persistency on a test cohort
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Head of Customer Service; Head of Contact Centre; Head of Renewals and Collections
roles.owns: Inbound and outbound call queues, scripts, quality checks
roles.cares_about: Language coverage, hand-off to humans, call recording and quality scores
roles.blocks_if: Agents see the bot as extra work; no regional-language quality proof
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Enterprise AI & Technology; CTO; CIO; Head of AI Lab
roles.owns: Integration with claims and policy systems, model testing, hosting
roles.cares_about: India hosting, API fit, test results on the insurer's own calls
roles.blocks_if: Data leaves India without approval; no integration with the policy admin system
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Chief Risk Officer; Chief Compliance Officer; Chief Information Security Officer; Grievance Redressal Officer
roles.owns: IRDAI rules on grievances, outsourcing, cyber security and records
roles.cares_about: IRDAI Master Circular on Protection of Policyholders' Interests 2024 (14-day complaint resolution; regional-language forms on request; call-centre tracking). IRDAI Information and Cyber Security Guidelines (CISO role). We have not read the 2026 version in full.
roles.blocks_if: Voice agent cannot show call records, audit trail and human escalation; unclear cyber-security sign-off
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Head of Procurement; Head of Vendor Management; IT sourcing lead
roles.owns: Vendor onboarding, contract terms, price comparison
roles.cares_about: Published per-minute price, exit terms, IRDAI outsourcing and IT-procurement oversight (a law-firm note says the 2026 cyber guidelines add IT procurement oversight; UNCHECKED)
roles.blocks_if: Needs a quote to compare; contract lacks IRDAI audit access
roles.label: UNCHECKED

roles.typical_titles: Head of Digital; Head of AI Lab; Head of Customer Experience; TPA or broker technology lead
roles.owns: Pilots and internal proof
roles.cares_about: Niva Bupa says GenAI is in production through its AI Lab (FOUNDER). Star Health says bots ran 7.5 million call minutes (FOUNDER). A champion wants a pilot that reports a number.
roles.blocks_if: No quick pilot path; vendor needs a long contract first
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: CEO or Group CEO; Managing Director; Unit head of a hospital cluster
roles.owns: Network budget, new-city plans, vendor spend
roles.cares_about: Occupancy, ARPOB (revenue per occupied bed), cost per patient contact, ramp-up of new hospitals
roles.blocks_if: Cannot see a payback inside the quarter; patient-safety or brand risk
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Head of Patient Experience; Head of Contact Centre; Chief Marketing and Customer Officer; Head of Patient Acquisition
roles.owns: Appointment calls, lead conversion, patient follow-up, call centre staff
roles.cares_about: Missed calls, lead conversion, patient satisfaction, regional language reach. Example title: Chief Marketing and Customer Officer at Redcliffe Labs (Exotel page).
roles.blocks_if: Voice agent hurts patient trust or duplicates the current CRM
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Contact centre team lead; front-desk and OPD registration head; TPA desk and revenue cycle head
roles.owns: Daily call queues, pre-authorisation calls, discharge-day calls
roles.cares_about: Fewer abandoned calls, clean hand-off to a person, claim turnaround
roles.blocks_if: Bot adds work when it hands off with no context
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Information Officer; Chief Digital Officer; Head of IT and HIS (hospital information system)
roles.owns: HIS, CRM and telephony integration, vendor security review
roles.cares_about: Integration with HIS and CRM, ABDM links, uptime, data location. Rainbow says it is building a new CRM and HIS design.
roles.blocks_if: No API into the HIS; data leaves India; no audit log
roles.label: FOUNDER

roles.typical_titles: Medical Director; Chief Medical Officer; Head of Quality (clinical safety blocker)
roles.owns: Clinical protocols, what a bot may say to a patient
roles.cares_about: No medical advice from the bot, fast hand-off to a nurse or doctor, NABH quality rules
roles.blocks_if: Bot answers a clinical question or gives a result
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Data privacy officer; Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
roles.owns: DPDP Act consent notice, retention, breach duty
roles.cares_about: Consent before outbound health calls, data kept in India, audit trail. Rule 4 (consent managers) starts 14 Nov 2026. Rules 3 and 5 to 16 start 18 months after 14 Nov 2025.
roles.blocks_if: No consent record per call; no deletion path
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Head of Procurement; Head of Purchase and Supply Chain; Group CFO office
roles.owns: Vendor onboarding, price terms, contract
roles.cares_about: Per-minute price against the cost of agent time, pilot with a pass bar, exit terms
roles.blocks_if: No fixed price; no named hospital reference
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Group COO; Chief Digital Officer; Group Director for growth
roles.owns: New-hospital launches, shared services
roles.cares_about: Faster ramp of new hospitals; one script set across states. Example: Narayana lists a Group Chief Operating Officer on its call.
roles.blocks_if: Pilot needs hospital staff time they do not have
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Secretary or Principal Secretary (IT / e-Governance); Chairman of the state IT agency
roles.owns: The budget and the final approval of the tender
roles.cares_about: Citizen reach, cost per call against the current call centre, and a clean audit trail
roles.blocks_if: The tender is not approved by the department, or the cost model does not fit the approved budget
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: CEO or Managing Director of the state e-governance agency; Mission CEO; helpline project head
roles.owns: The service (a helpline, a portal or a scheme) and its service targets
roles.cares_about: Fewer long waits, more calls solved the first time, more languages covered
roles.blocks_if: The bot lowers call quality, or citizens cannot reach a person when needed
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Helpline or call centre head; project manager at the agency
roles.owns: Daily call handling and the human agents. The MP 181 RFP lists about 800 agents and 50000-60,000 inbound calls a day
roles.cares_about: Hand-off to a live agent with full context, queue length, shift cover
roles.blocks_if: The bot cannot pass a call to a person, or the agents lose context
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Technical Evaluation Committee; agency CTO; NIC or NeGD technical staff
roles.owns: The live demo and the pass or fail scoring in the RFP
roles.cares_about: Language detection and switching, interruptions, accuracy on real calls, logs
roles.blocks_if: The bot fails the demo. The MP RFP marks demo items 'Qualified/ Not Qualified'
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Data protection and security officer; CERT-In empanelled auditor; CAG audit
roles.owns: Data residency, AI governance, consent and audit
roles.cares_about: Citizen data stays in India. The MP RFP clause 7.14 bars processing outside India unless the agency approves
roles.blocks_if: The vendor cannot show where data and logs sit
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: GeM buyer; agency purchase cell; the PSU or system integrator that holds the bid
roles.owns: The bid process, eligibility and the contract. The Odisha RFP accepted bids only from Central or State PSUs engaged in IT/ITeS. The MP RFP exempts DPIIT-recognised startups from turnover and GST pre-qualification
roles.cares_about: Eligibility, bid security, a clean empanelment
roles.blocks_if: The vendor is not eligible alone. Sarvam would then need a PSU or a system integrator as the bidder (INFERENCE)
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Bhashini Ecosystem Enablement lead for Government and Public Services; state IT officer who runs the language projects
roles.owns: Pushes language technology inside the state and links vendors to national programmes
roles.cares_about: Bhashini language coverage, scheme reach in local languages
roles.blocks_if: Prefers an in-house or Bhashini-only build
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Managing Director and CEO; CFO; circle or business-unit CEO
roles.owns: Budget for customer care and AI spend
roles.cares_about: Cost per call, churn, ARPU
roles.blocks_if: Gross margin hit; no proof from a pilot
roles.label: PUBLISHED

roles.typical_titles: Chief Customer Experience Officer; Chief Marketing or Consumer Business head
roles.owns: Customer care outcomes and plan sales
roles.cares_about: Complaints, retention, regional reach
roles.blocks_if: Language quality drops; brand risk
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Head of Contact Centre; Head of Customer Care; BPO vendor lead
roles.owns: Daily call handling and agent teams
roles.cares_about: Calls answered fast, handle time
roles.blocks_if: Agents lose control of the call flow
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: CTO; CIO; Head of Digital and AI
roles.owns: Platform fit, telephony link, data hosting
roles.cares_about: Latency, integration with billing and CRM, data stays in India
roles.blocks_if: Builds in-house first (Airtel, BSNL did)
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Regulatory Affairs head; Chief Legal and Compliance Officer
roles.owns: TRAI quality-of-service rules, recording and consent
roles.cares_about: Meeting TRAI call-centre benchmarks
roles.blocks_if: Unclear data handling or call recording rules
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Head of Procurement; BSNL and MTNL tender officer
roles.owns: Vendor selection and contract terms
roles.cares_about: Price per minute, SLA, local hosting
roles.blocks_if: Single-vendor lock-in; no tender route
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Circle CEO; Circle customer care head
roles.owns: Regional pilots in one circle
roles.cares_about: Local-language service for new rural subscribers
roles.blocks_if: No local-language pilot budget
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Vice Chancellor, Director, Registrar (institutions); CEO, Whole-time Director, Group CEO (edtech)
roles.owns: The budget and the final yes. At IIM Udaipur the Director has the final say on most day-to-day cases.
roles.cares_about: Reach in new languages, cost per admission, brand risk.
roles.blocks_if: He sees no clear cost cut or enrolment gain, or a pilot touches the brand before it is proven.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Head of Admissions, Head of Sales and Counselling, Chief Business Officer, Dean (Programs)
roles.owns: Enquiry-to-enrolment targets and the counsellor team.
roles.cares_about: Speed to first call, qualified leads, counsellor hours.
roles.blocks_if: Voice quality drops in the caller's language, or leads reach counsellors with no context.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Counselling team lead, call centre head, student support head, content operations head
roles.owns: The daily call queue, doubt desk and dubbing or translation workflow.
roles.cares_about: Easy hand-off to a human, call recordings, fewer repeat calls.
roles.blocks_if: The tool adds work, or it cannot escalate a hard call.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: CTO, Chief Technology Officer, Head of Product, Head of Engineering
roles.owns: The test of speech, translation and CRM links.
roles.cares_about: Accuracy on colloquial speech, API fit, uptime, data location.
roles.blocks_if: The model fails on the team's own recordings.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Data protection officer, General Counsel, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
roles.owns: Consent, children's data and student privacy.
roles.cares_about: Parent consent for minors, where data sits, call recording rules.
roles.blocks_if: No clear answer on minors' data. DPDP rules need full compliance by May 2027.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: CFO, Chief of Administration, purchase officer; GeM buyer for public bodies
roles.owns: Contract terms, price and the tender route.
roles.cares_about: Unit price per minute or page, volume tiers, tender fit.
roles.blocks_if: The price is above the firm's current cost per minute. PhysicsWallah says about Rs 2.7 a minute (its shareholder letter).
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Dean (Programs), Head of Centre for Teaching and Learning, Chief Content Officer, product head
roles.owns: The pilot and the case to the Director or CEO.
roles.cares_about: Better learner experience, faster content in a new language.
roles.blocks_if: He has no data from his own content to show his boss.
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Country head; Managing Director India; Site leader; CEO and Managing Director of the India centre
roles.owns: The India centre budget and the choice of tools for its own staff
roles.cares_about: Proof that the tool works for India staff; low run cost; no clash with the parent's global tools
roles.blocks_if: The parent already picked a global tool for the same job, or the head has no budget line for a new tool
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Head of AI; Head of Engineering India; Chief Technology Officer and Managing Director of the India centre
roles.owns: Model tests, integration and the pilot design
roles.cares_about: Accuracy on real data; hosting in India; links to existing HR and ticket systems; token cost
roles.blocks_if: The pilot cannot reach production data, or the model fails the team's own test set
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Parent-company chief information officer; chief information and AI officer; chief risk officer; chief information security officer
roles.owns: Approval of any AI tool that touches parent data or staff data
roles.cares_about: Data stays in approved places; audit trail; vendor risk review; one approved AI stack
roles.blocks_if: The tool sends data outside the approved cloud, or lacks an audit trail. The Dell-Zinnov report says GCCs often add governance after the pilot, so pilots stall
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Parent-company procurement or vendor management; India centre finance and admin head
roles.owns: Vendor onboarding, contract terms and price checks
roles.cares_about: Standard contract; security questionnaire passed; a price that fits an existing category
roles.blocks_if: The vendor is not on the parent's approved list, or the contract needs a global legal review
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Head of HR India; Head of shared services; Head of customer operations; business unit leads
roles.owns: The use case (onboarding, HR queries, support calls) and the success measure
roles.cares_about: Faster onboarding; fewer repeat questions; staff and new hires in their own language
roles.blocks_if: No clear number to improve, or the unit prefers its global vendor
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: HR operations lead at the new city site; local hires; site admin team
roles.owns: Daily use of the onboarding and HR assistant
roles.cares_about: Answers in the hire's own language; works on a phone; no new login
roles.blocks_if: The assistant speaks only English or Hindi, so local hires ignore it
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: IT services side: Chief Technology Officer and Head of Ecosystems; Chief AI and Innovation Officer; head of alliances
roles.owns: Partner choice for AI models in the firm's platforms and in client deals
roles.cares_about: A model that wins client tests; sovereign and India-hosted options; margin on the deal
roles.blocks_if: The firm already holds frontier-model deals (HCLTech also signed Anthropic and Cohere in the same quarter)
roles.label: VENDOR

roles.typical_titles: IT services side: Chief Growth Officer; President of the India business; CEO and Managing Director
roles.owns: Deal flow, pricing and the AI revenue target
roles.cares_about: Win rate on AI deals; price pressure; clients who ask for India-hosted models
roles.blocks_if: The client asks for a different model, or the margin is too thin after model costs
roles.label: VENDOR

roles.typical_titles: Managing Director and Group CEO; CEO; Founder CEO
roles.owns: Total budget for customer care and growth
roles.cares_about: Cost per order and per contact; growth in new cities
roles.blocks_if: The case shows no saving in the P&L
roles.label: VENDOR

roles.typical_titles: CEO of a business unit (Instamart, Food Marketplace); Chief Business Officer
roles.owns: New-city launch, dealer growth, seller growth
roles.cares_about: Order growth; dealer reach; repeat rate
roles.blocks_if: A pilot slows a launch
roles.label: VENDOR

roles.typical_titles: Head of customer care; Head of seller or dealer operations; Retail Head
roles.owns: Daily calls, tickets, returns and onboarding
roles.cares_about: Handle time; peak-day load; local-language cover
roles.blocks_if: The bot cannot hand over to a human
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Technology Officer; Chief Digital & Information Officer; Chief Product Officer
roles.owns: Links to order, CRM and telephony systems
roles.cares_about: API fit; delay in replies; data held in India
roles.blocks_if: No API for order lookup
roles.label: VENDOR

roles.typical_titles: General Counsel; Company Secretary; consumer-protection compliance lead
roles.owns: Consumer Protection Act duties; CCPA dark-pattern self-declaration; NCH replies
roles.cares_about: Wrong refund promises; no clear way to reach a person; call records
roles.blocks_if: No call record or audit trail
roles.label: VENDOR

roles.typical_titles: Head of Procurement; vendor management; CFO signs
roles.owns: Vendor choice and contract terms
roles.cares_about: Per-minute price; telephony extras; exit terms
roles.blocks_if: Total cost after telephony is unclear
roles.label: INFERENCE

roles.typical_titles: Chief Growth Officer; Chief Marketing Officer; Head of CX; Chief Customer Officer
roles.owns: Vernacular marketing and customer experience goals
roles.cares_about: Conversion in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns; repeat purchase; CSAT
roles.blocks_if: No proof in the local language
roles.label: INFERENCE
